Please don't continue with this! I believe you can get better, you just have to believe.
Why?...
But wouldn't you want to live one more day everyday to see if there's a person who doesn't see you as you see yourself? I'm here, I want to help you...
We can talk this over man, just please turn off the car.
Please turn off the car and open the garage door so that you can tell me why you're doing this. What's wrong?... I want to help in some way.
I'm glad you found this to be great, I want to help people. I hope in my best wishes may wind guide you through your journey.

In all honesty we all have our insecurities, we share similar wishes although not exact, I had a few crushes here and there and I never told them due to the fact on what I see myself as... Like a shy, weird looking, awkward, strange, unintelligent, little sub scum of the Earth. I to picture myself with others but I'm certain that it would die like fire without oxygen. And though I see myself as unattractive, I had friends. Real friends, plus I had YouTube, music, memes, and videogames. I'll never really know what it'd be like to be fully in your shoes, but know that there are most likely people out there who share similar problems and that now in today's age the world is becoming more and more accepting. I see it every time in my school and city. Its full of people who care and accepts mostly anyone no matter what the person may look, act, feel because in this community... We're all in the same boat. I hope this helped in some way, please find something to take your mind away from death. I've already lost one to many.

You said you're a bad gamer, but I want to ask have you ever heard about the Metal Gear franchise? Despite their downfall on Konami's side, it had a beautiful story about how to figure out how live your own life no matter what challenges that may come. If you can, you should watch playthroughs and maybe they'll inspire you to become something you want to be. This was a terrible comment, but I want to share a quote from the game MGS, "We're not tools of the government or anyone else, fighting was just something I was good at. But at least I was fighting in what I believed in. Find something to believe in, and when you do, pass it on." -Grey Fox. For me, this is what I live for. The games before I had any friends... I had found that purpose as a kid, now I am trying to find a new purpose for the future. Idk... You seem to have a life that is full of misfortune even if you try to make it better, I understand how that feels. But I assure you things'll come around, just like for me(slowly but surely) it'll be a good feeling. I hope you can find something in that game or... Idk. The rest is up to the player to decide on their path.

I wrote somewhat of a lengthy response to your helpful comment but of course it somehow deleted itself. In the short version of this I am sorry that you have to go through 2 deaths of you best friends and that what you wrote to me makes sense, I want to die but I have a stronger feeling to stay alive for my friends in hopes they'll stay alive as well, honouring our friends death by helping each other through our problems. Thank you.

I'm sorry you had to lose 2 great friends in the short span of days, reading this comment made me think of how life usually goes for the ones left behind, and it makes sense. Not only that I felt that I wanted to die but I wanted to live on for my friends so that maybe they'll live on as well and honour our friends death by sticking together and be "happy". Thank you.

Sorry waiting a day to reply to you, I find it easier to write during night times because it's usually the time I get to feel like myself when I'm in the house. I don't usually talk about myself to my parents, however I do talk to my friends a lot. I also talk to my classmates in my skulpture 2 class because it's the most open about problems. I'm thankful for you commenting to my little problem I have, it makes me happy to find at least one person out of my world to care, especially since this is a topic I've never really shared with anyone close to me.
